cover: Which one are you getting tonight?

cards.text: Take a sip. A big, beautiful sip. Bigger. BIGGER!
Steal a sip from somebody else's drink. They won't notice. Nobody notices.
Last one to say Donald Thump is the best has to drink! Go! GO!
You and the last guy, drink. Both of those punches were sad. Very sad!
EVERYBODY DRINKS! The whole room! Tremendous!
